evidence: The paper employs learning curves with AUC as performance metric and negative binomial regression to model dataset-level characteristics (class imbalance, feature count, nonlinearity) predicting sample sizes. It contains no feature importance analysis. "Core linear features" are identified via LASSO regression shrinkage in logistic regression, not tree-based impurity. The only coefficients reported are regression estimates on dataset characteristics, not feature importance magnitudes or rankings.
